repos.name: lantern-notes
repos.description: A tiny markdown journal that syncs to nowhere in particular.
repos.diagnosis: Still warm. Someone touched this two days ago and the cursor is practically still blinking.
repos.seance: It stirs eagerly, as if it never considered the possibility of rest.

repos.name: fenwick-timer
repos.description: A pomodoro timer with an unreasonable number of chime options.
repos.diagnosis: A faint pulse. Three weeks of quiet, but nothing a fresh commit couldn't cure.
repos.seance: It hums a half-remembered chime and waits to be wound again.

repos.name: cobweb-cli
repos.description: Command-line helper for renaming files in bulk, carefully.
repos.diagnosis: Dust is gathering. A month and a half of silence has settled over the keys.
repos.seance: It coughs once, shakes off the cobwebs, and asks what year it is.

repos.name: hollow-atlas
repos.description: An experimental map renderer that only ever drew one island.
repos.diagnosis: Barely breathing. Nearly three months quiet, teetering on the edge of the long sleep.
repos.seance: It gestures faintly at an unfinished coastline and drifts off mid-sentence.

repos.name: dusk-scheduler
repos.description: A cron-like task runner that nobody scheduled anything with.
repos.diagnosis: Four months in the ground. The limbs still move but the eyes have gone dim.
repos.seance: It lurches upright, mutters about a retry loop, and forgets what it was retrying.

repos.name: gravel-parser
repos.description: A config parser for a format that only this repo ever used.
repos.diagnosis: Most of a year undisturbed. It shambles, but the grammar it parsed is already dead.
repos.seance: It recites a syntax no living tongue remembers and reaches for your collar.

repos.name: moth-metrics
repos.description: A dashboard that charted exactly one afternoon of data.
repos.diagnosis: Well over a year gone. The flesh hangs loose and the charts have all flatlined.
repos.seance: It raises a single trembling bar chart toward the moon and groans.

repos.name: barrow-sync
repos.description: A file sync daemon abandoned halfway through conflict resolution.
repos.diagnosis: Two and a half years down. A hulking, decayed thing still clutching an unresolved merge.
repos.seance: It drags a broken merge behind it and asks, hopefully, which side wins.

repos.name: crypt-keeper
repos.description: A password vault prototype that outlived its own threat model.
repos.diagnosis: Over three and a half years interred. The oldest, most withered walker in the yard.
repos.seance: It rasps an encryption scheme deprecated a decade ago and will not stop shuffling toward you.

repos.name: harvest-engine
repos.description: A small 2D game engine that actually shipped a playable demo.
repos.lastCommitMessage: v1.0 release: ship the harvest demo
repos.diagnosis: This one is finished, not fallen. A real release, a real homepage, a crowd that remembers it.
repos.seance: It stands composed beneath a carved name and feels no need to rise.

repos.name: willow-ui
repos.description: A component library that reached a tidy, documented 1.0.
repos.diagnosis: Archived with honors: releases shipped, docs written, a job done and set down on purpose.
repos.seance: It rests easy under polished marble, work complete, and politely declines to be disturbed.

repos.name: tin-can-chat
repos.description: A websocket chat experiment that never got past echo.
repos.lastCommitMessage: wip: get the echo server working
repos.diagnosis: Sealed away unfinished. No release, no docs, just an echo that never found a voice.
repos.seance: It knocks twice from inside a nailed-shut box and goes quiet again.

repos.name: ember-notes
repos.description: A note-taking rewrite the author declared complete and walked away from.
repos.diagnosis: Marked finished by its own author. The grave was chosen, not dug by neglect.
repos.seance: It nods once, content, and settles back beneath a self-written epitaph.

repos.name: null-pointer-bistro
repos.description: A restaurant-ordering app that the author gave up on entirely.
repos.lastCommitMessage: temp: hardcode the menu for now
repos.diagnosis: Scrapped on purpose. The author nailed the lid shut and threw away the hammer.
repos.seance: It refuses to stir at all, having made its peace with the dark.

repos.name: phoenix-draft
repos.description: An old blogging engine the author swears they will resurrect any day now.
repos.diagnosis: Recently summoned back. A revive was declared five days ago and the window is still open.
repos.seance: It glows faintly, half-risen, waiting to see whether the promise will be kept in time.
